statement: Crusoe signed a $13 billion, five-year cloud contract to supply Jane Street with GPUs and other AI infrastructure.
why: A multi-year contracted backlog of this size underwrites accelerator purchases and shows demand widening beyond AI labs into quantitative finance.

impact.mechanism: Contracted multi-year revenue gives the operator the visibility and collateral to commit to large GPU fleet purchases in advance of deployment.

evidence.excerpt: Crusoe recently signed a $13 billion, five-year cloud contract to supply quantitative trading firm Jane Street with GPUs and other AI infrastructure through Crusoe's cloud platform

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; contract terms not disclosed in a filing.
